sources.title: Noncommutative-geometry wormholes without exotic matter

evidence.text: Use the Lorentzian smeared density ρ(r)=μ√β/[π²(r²+β)²]. The paper first obtains a shape function through the F=1 relation ρ=b′/r², fixes its integration constant at the throat, and uses the curvature relation R=2b′/r².

sources.title: A viable wormhole model in a five-dimensional spacetime

evidence.text: An orthonormal coframe is used to compute exterior derivatives, connection one-forms, and curvature two-forms through Cartan structural equations; Riemann components are extracted and traced to obtain the Ricci tensor.

sources.title: Noncommutative-geometry wormholes without exotic matter

evidence.text: Attempt an f(R) reconstruction from F=df/dR=r²ρ/b′, substituting the stated r(R)=√(2b′/R), expressing F(R), and integrating to the displayed f(R). Test material combinations ρ+p_r and ρ+p_t using the modified field equations, followed by an effective radial NEC test.

sources.title: A viable wormhole model in a five-dimensional spacetime

evidence.text: Einstein equations convert null stress-tensor contractions into Ricci sums. These are evaluated at the throat, where 1−b(r0)/r0=0, separately for radial, angular, and extra-dimensional null directions.

sources.title: Accounting for the large radial tension in Morris–Thorne wormholes

evidence.text: What accounts for the enormous radial tension required by moderately sized Morris–Thorne wormholes, beyond identifying their matter as NEC violating? The paper considers noncommutative smearing, its combination with f(R) gravity, and a small extra spatial dimension.

sources.title: Wormholes supported by small extra dimensions

evidence.text: Can a microscopic extra spatial dimension support a Morris–Thorne wormhole while allowing ordinary matter at its throat, with the required null-energy violation occurring in the five-dimensional sector? How does the large throat tension constrain this proposal?

evidence.text: Can traversable wormholes exist in f(Q) and f(Q,T) gravity with halo matter, monopole charge, quark matter or noncommutative density profiles, and under what conditions do they require NEC-violating matter?

sources.title: Derivation of the Null Energy Condition

evidence.text: Transform the resulting null-contracted string-frame curvature equation to Einstein frame. For reduction, calculate higher- and lower-dimensional Ricci tensors and compare their contractions with the lifted null vectors.

sources.title: On Coupling NEC-Violating Matter to Gravity

evidence.text: Uses the null Raychaudhuri equation to connect Ricci convergence with focusing. Applied to event-horizon generators, finite-affine-time focusing and cosmic censorship support the classical area law and its thermodynamic interpretation.

sources.title: Holographic Consequences of a No Transmission Principle

evidence.text: Use Fefferman–Graham asymptotics to argue that finite boundary curvature contributes only subleading bulk curvature: the displayed scalar curvature is R = −d(d+1) + z²R0. Together with localization of quantum effects, this supports a fixed boundary metric away from the singular time.

sources.title: Two Roads to the Null Energy Condition

evidence.text: An arbitrary target-space null vector is represented locally by ∂+X0 of a test string. The next-order constraint is then transformed from string frame to Einstein frame, converting a dilaton-Hessian equality into a nonnegative squared derivative.

sources.title: Derivation of the Null Energy Condition

evidence.text: Use a background-field expansion X = X0 + Y and Riemann normal coordinates around X0. Integrating out Y at one worldsheet loop introduces a divergent counterterm proportional to the spacetime Ricci tensor, together with the dilaton contribution to the constraints.

sources.title: Derivation of the Null Energy Condition

evidence.text: Vary the worldsheet metric to obtain the Virasoro constraints T++ = T−− = 0. At zeroth order these identify ∂±Xμ as spacetime null vectors, supplying the null contractions needed for the geometric condition.

sources.title: Solving the Naturalness Problem by Baby Universes in the Lorentzian Multiverse

evidence.text: Can microscopic wormholes dynamically select couplings in a Lorentzian multiverse, addressing the cosmological constant, gauge hierarchy and strong CP problems without anthropic selection?

sources.title: Torsional instanton effects in quantum gravity

evidence.text: Can the Giddings–Strominger semi-wormhole be interpreted as an on-shell torsional instanton carrying Nieh–Yan charge, and can tunneling between those charge sectors realize a topological quantum vacuum associated with the Barbero–Immirzi parameter?

sources.title: Eternal traversable wormhole

evidence.text: Can an interaction between two boundaries support a static eternal traversable wormhole, and can two coupled SYK systems realize its gravitational dynamics, excitation spectrum and thermodynamics?

sources.title: Charged eigenstate thermalization, Euclidean wormholes and global symmetries in quantum gravity

evidence.text: How should ETH describe charged operators, and can Euclidean-wormhole predictions for charged one-point-function variances distinguish microscopic charge conservation from exponentially weak violations and constrain exact bulk global symmetries?

sources.title: Bra-ket wormholes and Casimir entropy

evidence.text: How does integrating gauge holonomies change the negative Casimir energy supporting bra-ket wormholes, their existence and dominance, and the proposed resolution of the strong-subadditivity paradox?

sources.title: Axion-de Sitter wormholes

evidence.text: What regular Euclidean axion wormholes exist with positive cosmological constant, how stable and semiclassically weighted are they, and can their Lorentzian continuations describe quantum bridges between expanding de Sitter-like universes?

sources.title: Supporting traversable wormholes: the case for noncommutative geometry

evidence.text: Can a noncommutative-geometry matter model account for NEC violation and enormous throat tension in traversable wormholes, while supplying a complete metric from specified physical conditions?

sources.title: Wormholes supported by small extra dimensions

evidence.text: Can a microscopic extra spatial dimension support a Morris–Thorne wormhole while allowing ordinary matter at its throat, with the required null-energy violation occurring in the five-dimensional sector? How does the large throat tension constrain this proposal?

sources.title: Study of wormholes in symmetric teleparallel theories of gravity

evidence.text: Can traversable wormholes exist in f(Q) and f(Q,T) gravity with halo matter, monopole charge, quark matter or noncommutative density profiles, and under what conditions do they require NEC-violating matter?

sources.title: Wormholes and the imaginary distance bound

evidence.text: Does the appearance of wormholes supported by imaginary scalar fields bound analytic continuation of a single gravitational theory's couplings, and do intrinsic string-theory effects invalidate its low-energy description at or before that bound?

sources.title: Axionic Wormholes in Metric-Affine Gravity

evidence.text: Can non-minimal couplings of a dynamical PQ scalar to curvature, Holst and Nieh–Yan terms in metric-affine gravity increase axionic wormhole actions enough to suppress wormhole-induced PQ violation, while admitting representative inflation-compatible parameters?

sources.title: Asymptotically anti-de Sitter wormholes

evidence.text: Can asymptotically anti-de Sitter wormholes admit a finite, gauge-invariant Euclidean variational principle and a quantum Hilbert space whose physical states are superpositions of wormhole wave functions?

sources.title: Instability of space-time due to Euclidean wormholes

evidence.text: Does the Giddings–Strominger Euclidean wormhole contribute a real or imaginary term to the forward flat-space amplitude, and can baby-universe emission produce loss of coherence in the parent subsystem?

sources.title: Wormholes and global symmetries

evidence.text: Do Euclidean wormholes violate the global U(1) symmetry of a minimally coupled complex scalar theory in both its broken and unbroken phases, and how should their effects be matched onto local low-energy interactions when the wormhole action is infinite?

sources.title: Solving the Naturalness Problem by Baby Universes in the Lorentzian Multiverse

evidence.text: Minisuperspace path integration over the lapse gives δ(H); canonical quantisation and WKB applied to √z φE determine the parent-universe wavefunction. Integration over both signs of lapse also sums over the ordering of the boundary surfaces.

sources.title: Torsional instanton effects in quantum gravity

evidence.text: Vary independently with respect to the connection, B and tetrad. Decompose ω into a torsionless connection plus contortion, use the connection and B equations, and express the tetrad equation through the torsionless curvature to recover the Giddings–Strominger equations.

sources.title: Eternal traversable wormhole

evidence.text: Beyond low energies, the authors solve collective G,Σ Schwinger–Dyson equations numerically and analytically at large q. The latter uses Liouville equations at short times matched to long-time fermionic oscillator correlators.

sources.title: Charged eigenstate thermalization, Euclidean wormholes and global symmetries in quantum gravity

evidence.text: Use a sum over quotient images for the scalar wormhole correlator, analyze boundary symmetry charges and Wilson-line dressings in the gauged case, and interpret wormhole contributions as coarse-grained moments of microscopic CFT observables.

sources.title: Bra-ket wormholes and Casimir entropy

evidence.text: Integrate over throat modulus b and U(N) holonomy eigenvalues. The effective action combines JT gravity φr b²/(2πL), Weyl anomaly bN/24, a holonomy-dependent Casimir term, and logarithmic eigenvalue repulsion from the Haar measure. Large-N eigenvalue density and the b saddle are solved together.

sources.title: Axion-de Sitter wormholes

evidence.text: Studies turning points of the Euclidean Friedmann constraint and evaluates the on-shell action by quadrature between minimum and maximum scale factors. The d=3 metric and action are explicit; the d=4 action is integrated numerically and compared with a linear flux approximation.

sources.title: Traversable wormholes with arbitrarily small energy condition violations

evidence.text: Does supporting a traversable wormhole require a large total quantity of energy-condition-violating matter, or can a suitable quantitative measure become arbitrarily small?

sources.title: Asymptotically Vanishing Cosmological Constant in the Multiverse

evidence.text: Can a baby-universe mechanism favor a vanishing cosmological constant in Lorentzian quantum cosmology, where the interpretation and tunneling sign of Coleman's Euclidean enhancement are problematic?

sources.title: Cosmology from confinement?

evidence.text: Can completely specified nongravitational field theories encode four-dimensional homogeneous, isotropic big-bang/big-crunch cosmologies through confinement, connected Euclidean wormholes, and analytic continuation?

sources.title: Wormholes made without massless matter fields

evidence.text: Can Euclidean wormholes exist without massless matter fields, and how do their charge, throat size, and effective operator insertions behave in a theory containing only a massive charged scalar and gravity?

sources.title: Baby Universes, Holography, and the Swampland

evidence.text: Euclidean wormholes can introduce spacetime-independent coupling labels, whereas higher-dimensional quantum gravity is expected to have no freely adjustable parameters. The paper asks whether topology-changing quantum redundancies can reconcile these claims without replacing a single holographic boundary theory by an ensemble.

sources.title: Interacting systems and wormholes

evidence.text: Can two QFTs coupled through a higher-dimensional messenger reproduce the nonfactorising source functional and ultraviolet-soft cross correlators expected for Euclidean wormholes, while permitting meaningful Lorentzian continuations?

sources.title: Accounting for the large radial tension in Morris–Thorne wormholes

evidence.text: What accounts for the enormous radial tension required by moderately sized Morris–Thorne wormholes, beyond identifying their matter as NEC violating? The paper considers noncommutative smearing, its combination with f(R) gravity, and a small extra spatial dimension.

sources.title: Holographic Consequences of a No Transmission Principle

evidence.text: What restrictions on cosmological bounces, black-hole singularity resolution, and traversable wormholes follow from the inability of independent boundary quantum field theories to exchange signals?

sources.title: Noncommutative-geometry wormholes without exotic matter

evidence.text: Can a noncommutative-geometry-inspired smeared source be represented by a particular f(R) theory supporting a zero-tidal-force traversable wormhole whose material satisfies the NEC while its effective gravitational stress tensor violates it?

sources.title: Baby universes born from the void

evidence.text: Can wormholes and a nontrivial third-quantized baby-universe Hilbert space coexist with holography and fixed microscopic couplings, replacing conventional averaged α-parameters?

sources.title: Notes on wormhole cancellation and factorization

evidence.text: Can complex phases attached to different connected bulk geometries make their contributions cancel, restoring partition-function factorization for decoupled boundaries while retaining individual wormholes and bulk topological modes?

sources.title: Traversable wormholes in four dimensions

evidence.text: Can ordinary charged quantum fields support a parametrically controlled, traversable four-dimensional wormhole without creating a shortcut through ambient space, and can its mouths and throat remain metastable?

sources.title: A viable wormhole model in a five-dimensional spacetime

evidence.text: Can a static wormhole with a small extra spatial dimension satisfy the four-dimensional null energy condition at its throat while assigning the required five-dimensional NEC violation to the extra direction?

sources.title: Negative modes in the four-dimensional stringy wormholes

evidence.text: Does the four-dimensional stringy Giddings–Strominger wormhole admit negative fluctuation modes, and what can these modes establish about its contribution to the Euclidean functional integral?

sources.title: Euclidean wormholes in string theory

evidence.text: Can a nonsingular Euclidean wormhole in a string background with a known CFT dual induce intrinsic randomness in couplings, even after the fundamental theory and vacuum are fixed? The proposed test requires localized wormhole ends that preserve the original boundary conditions.

sources.title: Traversable wormholes in AdS and bounds on information transfer

evidence.text: How much information can traverse a Gao–Jafferis–Wall wormhole while a controlled semiclassical bulk description remains valid, despite its very short opening, and how does this depend on black-hole size, species number and transverse localization?

sources.title: Wormholes in Maximal Supergravity

evidence.text: Do complex Euclidean wormholes exist in compactified supergravity, and can string theory include their saddle-point contributions? The paper distinguishes the classical existence problem from the compatibility of a complex integration contour with discrete gauge symmetry.

sources.title: Euclidean wormholes, baby universes, and their impact on particle physics and cosmology

evidence.text: Do Euclidean wormholes contribute to physical quantum gravity, and can their effects coexist with local effective field theory? The review treats censorship, baby-universe states, and the interpretation of coupling constants as unresolved questions even for large, low-curvature configurations.

sources.title: On Coupling NEC-Violating Matter to Gravity

evidence.text: Can classically NEC-violating matter effective theories couple consistently to gravity, and which changes to minimal Einstein coupling evade the obstructions suggested by black-hole thermodynamics and perturbative string theory?

sources.title: A Negative mode about Euclidean wormhole

evidence.text: Does the Giddings–Strominger Euclidean wormhole possess a negative fluctuation mode, and does this support an imaginary semiclassical contribution interpreted as emission of baby universes?

sources.title: Wormhole Renormalization: The gravitational path integral, holography, and a gauge group for topology change

evidence.text: Can effects of unknown microscopic wormholes be parametrized recursively, analogously to renormalization counterterms, to restore holographic factorization? What Hopf algebra and topology-changing group organize equivalent gravitational path-integral prescriptions?

sources.title: Euclidean Wormholes in Horava-Lifshitz Gravity

evidence.text: Can projectable Hořava-Lifshitz quantum cosmology admit Wheeler-DeWitt wave functions satisfying the Hawking-Page wormhole boundary conditions, including for nonzero cosmological constant?

sources.title: The Conformal Bootstrap

evidence.text: How can conformal symmetry, unitarity and OPE consistency constrain strongly coupled CFTs without choosing a microscopic Lagrangian? These pedagogical lectures develop the foundations and introduce numerical applications to the 2d and 3d Ising models.

sources.title: Comments on a state-operator correspondence for the torus

evidence.text: Can states of a three-dimensional CFT on a spatial two-torus admit a bijective state-operator correspondence based on compact Euclidean fillings? The central necessary test is whether such a filling can prepare the torus vacuum.

sources.title: The Conformal Bootstrap

evidence.text: Stress-tensor Ward identities and integrated topological surface charges establish symmetry actions. Radial quantization and the Weyl map to R × S^(d−1) translate operator statements into Hilbert-space statements.

sources.title: Comments on a state-operator correspondence for the torus

evidence.text: Vary the energy functional by inserting real sources for arbitrary operators; metric variations are included through stress-tensor insertions. Reflection symmetry combines bra and ket variations into twice an integrated connected stress-tensor–operator correlator.

sources.title: The Conformal Bootstrap

evidence.text: Conformal blocks are obtained from OPE differential operators, projectors onto conformal multiplets, or a quadratic-Casimir differential equation with OPE boundary conditions. Radial expansions organize descendants using Gegenbauer polynomials.

sources.title: The Conformal Bootstrap

evidence.text: Numerical searches use derivatives at z = z̄ = 1/2 through order Λ. Continuous dimension constraints are treated by discretized linear programming, continuous simplex methods, or positive-times-polynomial approximations and semidefinite programming.

sources.title: Comments on a state-operator correspondence for the torus

evidence.text: For a free conformally coupled scalar, compare the canonical Gaussian vacuum wave-functional with the Gaussian obtained from a filling. The latter requires restricting the propagator to the boundary before taking its inverse; spectral compatibility conditions are then stated.

sources.title: Comments on a state-operator correspondence for the torus

evidence.text: Compare the energy of the hemisphere-times-circle state with the torus Casimir energy. Stress-tensor symmetry and tracelessness relate its energy to the thermal energy on a sphere: Eψ = −(πL1/2L2)Eth, with sphere radius L2 and inverse temperature 2πL1.

sources.title: AdS Field Theory from Conformal Field Theory

evidence.text: Which bottom-up properties of CFT correlators guarantee a perturbative AdS effective field theory with a cutoff parametrically above the curvature scale, and what constraints follow for conserved higher-spin interactions?

sources.title: Modular invariance as completeness

evidence.text: How do generalized symmetries or violations of Haag duality appear in local CFT data? In two dimensions, can modular invariance characterize completeness, and can partition functions and entropies quantify its failure?

sources.title: Perturbative search for dead-end CFTs

evidence.text: The paper specializes imported three-loop beta functions for products of simple gauge groups, searches for nonzero fixed points, and diagonalizes the matrix ∂iβj at those points to obtain gauge-kinetic operator anomalous dimensions and infrared stability information.

sources.title: The Tension between 10D Supergravity and dS Uplifts

evidence.text: Redshift a small anti-D3 population in a warped throat and balance its positive tension energy against KKLT stabilization. The candidate minimum can decay by decompactification or brane-flux annihilation, while mixed corrections can change the potential.

sources.title: Perturbative search for dead-end CFTs

evidence.text: The mass-deformation analysis compares positive kinetic bilinears for real scalars and three-dimensional Majorana fermions with Hermitian kinetic bilinears for four-dimensional Weyl fermions. Gauge consistency is imposed through the summed cubic gauge-anomaly cancellation condition.

sources.title: The Tension between 10D Supergravity and dS Uplifts

evidence.text: Use a non-ISD flux critical point as the uplifting ingredient. The source reports a toroidal orientifold example and treats extension to other Calabi–Yau manifolds as plausible rather than demonstrated.

sources.title: The Tension between 10D Supergravity and dS Uplifts

evidence.text: Combine the external Einstein equation with the five-form Bianchi identity and integrate the resulting Φ⁻ equation. BPS sources cancel in the tension–charge combination; non-BPS and condensate contributions must be evaluated explicitly.

sources.title: The Tension between 10D Supergravity and dS Uplifts

evidence.text: Compute the F-term potential from K=−3 log(2σ−S S̄), then remove the constrained scalar. This retains uplift-sector auxiliary energy and mixed terms while leaving their compactification-dependent coefficient undetermined.
